recipes.reason: Restore vinegar and fish ingredient sections so the first instruction does not mix the entire recipe into dipping vinegar.
ingredients: Chipotle vinegar: ½ cup malt vinegar
Chipotle vinegar: 2–3 canned chipotle chiles in adobo, puréed until smooth
Fish: 1 bottle (12 oz) very cold beer
Fish: 3–4 canned chipotle chiles in adobo, puréed until smooth
Fish: 4 tilapia fillets, cut into 1-ounce strips
Serving: 1 recipe French fries, using chipotle powder instead of black pepper
steps: Make the chipotle vinegar by whisking its malt vinegar, 2–3 puréed chipotle chiles and pinch of salt in a dipping bowl. Keep at room temperature until needed.
Combine beer, cornmeal, Old Bay, Worcestershire sauce, 1 tbsp salt, 3–4 chipotles, and adobo sauce to make a batter.
Dredge fish pieces in cornstarch, then dip in the batter.
Fry coated fish pieces two at a time in oil at 350°F, about 3 minutes until golden and crisp outside.
Drain on a cooling rack above a baking pan. If the inside is undercooked, finish in a 350°F oven.
Serve with French fries and chipotle vinegar.

recipes.reason: Restore dough versus filling context for the instruction to combine all dry ingredients.
ingredients: Filling: Nutella or other chocolate spread
Filling: chopped nuts, such as almonds, walnuts, or pecans
steps: Preheat oven to 180°C.
Mix the dry dough ingredients together, add the water, and mix well with your hands.
Work into a large pliable ball. Cut in half.
Roll the first half out on a floured board to about ½ inch thick, 12–15 inches wide, and as long as possible within those dimensions.
Spread chocolate spread thickly and evenly over the dough, leaving about an inch free on all sides.
Cover the spread with banana slices. Sprinkle with nuts and chocolate chips if desired.
Roll one long side inwards to form a spiral log, keeping the filling tucked in.
Arrange on a baking tray, straight or curled as preferred.
Brush lightly with olive oil, sprinkle with more chopped nuts if desired, and proof in a warm place for 30 minutes.
Bake for 30–35 minutes in the preheated 180°C oven.
Use the second half to make another sweet bread or a savory bread. Fill and bake as above.

ingredients: 4 ounces semisweet chocolate, melted using a double boiler
Chopped hazelnuts, pecans, walnuts, or almonds (optional)
steps: Combine melted chocolate, syrup, sugar, and salt in a large bowl.
If using cookies or nuts, place them in a pie plate.
Add strawberries to the chocolate mixture and toss to coat. If using nuts or cookies, roll strawberries in them.
Insert a bamboo or wooden toothpick into the side of each fruit and refrigerate until coating sets.
Serve chilled.

ingredients: 4 slightly unripe bananas, peeled and halved lengthwise
½ cup (60 ml / 2 oz) dark rum
¼ cup (50 g / 1.8 oz) granulated sugar
steps: Combine all ingredients except bananas, powdered sugar, orange, and rum in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once mixture boils, add bananas, keeping at least ½ inch (1.3 cm) between them. Cook for 1 minute per side.

Remove bananas and keep warm. Bring mixture to a strong boil over high heat. Turn off heat and add rum. If it has not ignited by itself, carefully ignite with a firestick or long fireplace match. Wait until flames die out before stirring in zest.
Spoon sauce over bananas and dust with powdered sugar. Serve warm with ice cream.
